issues.description: Method Pneumatic.raisePressure: problem statement (UML) declares raisePressure(pressureIncrease: int) but the solution implements raisePressure(double pressureIncrease). The template Pneumatic.java does not declare the method signature. This mismatch of the parameter type (int vs. double) creates ambiguity for students about which signature to implement and can cause compilation or test failures if tests expect the int signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type for Pneumatic.raisePressure consistent across all artifacts. Either change the solution and any tests to use void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease) to match the UML, or update the UML/problem statement to declare raisePressure(pressureIncrease: double) and update the template/tests accordingly. Ensure the final choice is reflected identically in the problem statement, template interface, solution implementation, and tests.
